The loader runs these once with bpf_prog_test_run to arm the timer; missing them means the probe loads and never ticks.

`usdt__<provider>__<probe>`: the loader takes the FIRST `__` after the prefix, so a provider containing `__` is not representable -- which is why the loader carries an explicit 'malformed USDT prog name' diagnostic.
